artifact: CityMETER Grocery — where grocery stores concentrate against where people live, from the country down to local administrations and Bangkok Locales
derivedFrom: CityMETER Luxury Brands 0.5.0 (same layout, design system and handoff structure)

fontRoles.dataAndMetrics: JetBrains Mono 400; tabular numerals; normal tracking
fontRoles.navigation: Material Symbols Rounded approved nav-7 subset; FILL 0 / wght 300 / GRAD 0 / opsz 24
fontRoles.pictograms: Material Symbols Rounded 9-glyph pictogram subset (assets/icons/material-pictogram-300.woff2); FILL 0 / wght 300 / GRAD 0 / opsz 24; test exception to nav-7 approved by the owner 2026-10-22 (Luxury Brands), carried over

colors.applied: assets/theme.css — foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles (activeLayer, selectedStroke, markerHalo, markerStroke), data states (noData, zero), categorical series 1–10 (landometer-series-10-v8 soft), count and density.capita five-class tables with ink, basemap-only tokens (--basemap-*)
colors.analytical: js/scales.js — count (scaleVersion 4ff5c1fb4be71ecd13c48685b38371b528bcd4ce369ce964a75354c2eb4d0980) and density.capita (scaleVersion 0b49c15c6f91e48db79f5c6bd9c729656c95cd6f3162941490c5c125111b4ab1), 41-sample LUTs, identical HEX on both themes; the legend states the denominator (ต่อ 1 หมื่นคน)
colors.categorical: store types: C_STORE series-7, SUPERMARKET series-3, HYPERMARKET series-2, WHOLESALE series-8, PHARMACY series-1 (logos.css --type-*)
colors.notDistributed: full LDS library, other analytical families, Location Intelligence profile scales

firstAha: share of the area's stores held by its top children against their share of registered residents — ‘30% ของสาขาอยู่ใน 3 จังหวัดนี้ ซึ่งมีคนแค่ 13% ของประเทศ’ by default — recomputed at every drill level and filter; the map focuses those children automatically and keeps the rest quiet
areaUnit: production hierarchy (owner choice ‘A+อปท’ 2026-10-22): ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › อำเภอ/เขต › อปท./ย่าน; DOLA local administrations outside Bangkok, CityMETER Locales inside; membership, boundaries and population from production

focusAndQuiet.ownerInstruction: carried over from Luxury Brands (2026-10-22): show detail only for the focused part; keep the rest quiet
focusAndQuiet.implementation: app.js focus modes (auto/explicit/none) and fixed focus (unit, venue); area-layers.js focused/quiet fills, outlines and labels; stores-layer.js focus vs grey context dots; pins.js only for rows in focus from zoom 14

geometryAndMetricContract: one source row per dot; production membership for every area; distinct brands never summed across areas; the Aha share is a union; missing population is no data, never zero
accessibility: visible focus on every control including pins, chart marks and area labels
keyboard pin tour (arrow keys) excluding quiet context dots
table equivalent for every map view
empty, map-failure, geometry-failure and load-error paths with actions

validation.renderedHarness: Playwright + vendored MapLibre 5.6.2 + stub TileJSON with empty tiles; 1280×800 and 390×844; light and dark
validation.liveChecks: see handoff/VERIFICATION.md — the real-tile look is confirmed only there
validation.scope: Applied LDS assets, fonts and actual rendered interfaces. No blanket LDS, CVD, native-device or market-completeness claim.

layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, bottom sheet ≤ 64dvh with sticky close, compact Aha card with the breadcrumb on the map while the sheet is closed

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet (OpenMapTiles) with --basemap-* tokens; labels name:th first; no POI/housenumber/boundary labels
mapContract.layerOrder: landcover/water → area fills (before waterway) → 2D footprints → roads → massing tiers → buildings drawn as data (joined-buildings, before water-name) → venue x-ray (custom 3D layer) → labels → area outlines / selection → store dots → HTML labels and pins
mapContract.choropleth: count or density.capita, quantile up to five classes over the compared children on display-rounded values; fills stop at zoom 9 (provinces), 12 (districts), 14.5 (units); EVID-05 measured / measured_zero / no_data / out_of_scope
mapContract.stores: every filtered row a WebGL dot fading in at zoom 7–8; focus = store-type colour to zoom 14, context = small grey; from zoom 14 rows in focus become HTML pins with brand logos (≤ 450 pins, ≤ 250 logos)
mapContract.massing: city tier (OSM heights, quiet, 3D only) and a rounded focus tier around a compact open unit and around the buildings drawn as data; context only, never data; SCENE.eye (city 0.16, focus 0.62, see-through occluders) at venue level in the two-point view
mapContract.camera: plan for anything wider than 0.3°, for areas on mobile portrait and with 3D off · city (pitch 56, bearing 28) for a compact district · model (pitch 60, FOV 14) for a unit or a store outside every venue · eye (มุมสถาปนิก, pitch 75, FOV 24) at venue level by default (?cam=model opts out)
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › อำเภอ/เขต › อปท./ย่าน › สถานที่ with production keys (abbr, district code, DOLA code / Locale uuid, venue GV-/SC- id); store is the heading, not a crumb; a store in a venue ends at the venue; production links go out
mapContract.areaLabels: ink chips (--area-label-* tokens, display font, level pictogram, value badge) distinct from logo boxes; quiet labels faded
mapContract.venueBuildings: joined-buildings layers (js/spatial-layer.js) in --map-active-layer / --map-selected-stroke: อาคารของสถานที่ (venue_reference, 29 venues) at district/unit/venue level and อาคารตามพิกัดสาขา (point_inside) for a selected store or venue; the x-ray solid uses the same roles

brandIdentity.sources: 17 brands: 14 official sources, 3 retailer/reference; source artwork embedded unchanged, outer whitespace cropped in viewport only; backplates measured from the artwork
brandIdentity.fallback: visible brand names and accessible marker labels retained; logos are identity, not a metric or endorsement

venueLogos: 128 sha256-verified files for 2,547 of 3,542 registered venue names (mostly shared operator banners with a role caption); venue names, independent reference geometry and plotted-point containment are separate evidence, never confirmed tenancy

chartContract.ranking: paired bars: share of stores (class colour) and share of residents (neutral) per child; or stores per 10,000 residents
chartContract.matrix: table-layout fixed with a colgroup; every cell the same size; tint = count class of the cell

copy: short natural Thai without on-screen caveats: สาขา (one source row) / แบรนด์ / สถานที่ตามชื่อสาขา / อปท. / ย่าน / ประชากร / ต่อ 1 หมื่นคน; status ‘อยู่ในรายการสาขาของแบรนด์’
knownExceptions: assets/theme.css keeps 24 basemap-only literal HEX values (declared once per theme, never data colours), reported by the LDS artifact checker as in Luxury Brands
pictogram subset is a declared test exception to nav-7
venueLevel: release 0.2 (owner 2026-10-22, ‘in the same form as Luxury Brands’): สถานที่ is the fifth crumb and a map level — at district/unit level the accepted reference buildings of the venues in focus are drawn as อาคารของสถานที่ and open the venue; at venue level (a venue, or a store whose branch name names one) the two-point camera eye (มุมสถาปนิก) is the default, the massing goes quiet and see-through (SCENE.eye) and js/venue-xray.js draws the venue's buildings on top, clickable; evidence (name reference vs plotted point) is labelled separately and never read as tenancy
